children: According to Sina Finance, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said large-scale investment in artificial intelligence poses concentration risks to the U.S. economy. He said AI investment had been a major driver of U.S. economic growth in recent years, but could slow, potentially sharply, if it fails to boost productivity as expected or deliver the returns investors anticipate. He said economic growth would slow as a result.

Kashkari said it remains unclear whether AI will generate stronger productivity growth or other returns. He said he was optimistic about AI's prospects but urged openness to different outcomes, including the possibility that some investments could be misguided. He added that AI infrastructure construction is not the only factor driving inflation.

title: Neel Kashkari: Massive AI Investment Poses Concentration Risk to the Economy
